subject: FINDING compile time: 110 corpus kernels exceed 30 s CPU, all in the Mali phase, dominated by Bifrost register allocation (LCRA interference + spill cost)
body: Corpus replay timeouts (110 functions: 97 MPS/MPSNeuralNetwork, 12 Metal/other, 1 camera) are all in phase=mali (translator done). Rerun with 240 s budget so far: 10/12 compile OK in 38-46 s wall; 2 still >240 s. Example MPS MIBox_Horizontal_Scan_1Channel (29.5 KB SPIR-V -> 46 KB code): tegu_mali_compile v1 refuses in 0.02 s (texture kernel), compute_v2 21-22 s CPU. gdb SIGPROF samples (11/11) all inside bi_compile_variant_nir: bi_register_allocate -> lcra_add_node_interference/nodearray_sparse_search/nodearray_orr, bi_mark_interference, bi_compute_interference, compute_spill_cost/find_all_predecessors. I.e. RA interference graph + spill loop on very large shaders, not NIR passes. Repro: gpu/build/shader-coverage-20261027/runs/t-slow/cases/c-4affbe6621bdc2b816b5116c/compute.spv with scratchpad slow.py (ctypes tegu_mali_compile_compute_v2). Not a UI/CA path (all CA/UI compiles are <1 s); recorded as compile_budget_exceeded, not refusal.
